title: Qilimanjaro Pushes Analog Quantum as AI Compute Demands Surge
summary: Qilimanjaro Pushes Analog Quantum as AI Compute Demands Surge Qilimanjaro says analog quantum systems could reduce error correction and accelerate AI, optimization, and simulation. On May 28, its analog system joined the digital quantum computer at the Barcelona Supercomputing Center.
